body: [{"streamId":"01a1882f-8e3a-7000-ac09-37929e4998eb","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1882f-8e3a-7000-ac09-37929e4998eb\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022h9k epic add in a project that belongs to a solution creates a solution epic with no home project: its events are written to every member project\\u0027s ledger this node holds, receiving nodes de-duplicate by event id, and a project linked into the solution later receives the solution\\u0027s existing epics through the catch-up mechanism.\u0022,\u0022A project inside a solution cannot hold a project-only epic; a project outside any solution behaves exactly as today, and existing epics are untouched.\u0022,\u0022A task from any member project may join a solution epic at add or revise: the same-project membership check (EpicIdResolver.ResolveForMembershipAsync) becomes same-solution for a solution epic.\u0022,\u0022epic show and epic list compose member tasks across projects grouped by project, and a node shows only the tasks of projects it has joined, because tasks still replicate through their own project\\u0027s ledger alone.\u0022,\u0022The one-live-task-per-issue refusal (TaskAddCommand.RefuseSecondAdoptionAsync, reached from --from-issue, --from-jira, task link-issue and task link-jira) admits a second task when that task is in the same solution epic as the holder and in a different member project; every other case still refuses with the same message, and closeout\\u0027s existing all-linked-tasks-done rule (CloseoutEngine.AllOtherLinkedTasksClosedOutAsync) is what closes the issue.\u0022,\u0022Unlinking a project from its solution stops the solution\\u0027s epics fanning out to it; tasks already under those epics stay where they are and keep showing on the epic and the board, and the project may create project epics again.\u0022,\u0022Closing a solution epic stays an explicit human act with a reason; nothing closes one automatically.\u0022,\u0022Unit tests cover the fan-out decision, de-duplication on receipt, the same-solution membership check, the shared-issue admission and the unlink behaviour; no test creates a branch or touches GitHub.\u0022,\u0022docs/concepts.md, docs/scope.md and the hall9k-cli-reference skill describe solution epics, the shared-issue rule and unlink behaviour.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-29T15:06:21.937247\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"b6b67258-258f-4dd8-8a8e-a86a226a93a0","originSequence":139828,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-29T15:06:21.952882+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a187ae-89fb-73e3-9a59-f48af8212260","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Idea.IdeaConcluded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a187ae-89fb-73e3-9a59-f48af8212260\u0022,\u0022Reason\u0022:\u0022Discovery settled the shape as Solutions: linked one-repo projects under a named group, not a multi-repo project.
